Class ShadowNativeImageReader

java.lang.Object
org.robolectric.shadows.ShadowNativeImageReader
@Implements(value=ImageReader.class, minSdk=28, isInAndroidSdk=false, shadowPicker=ShadowNativeImageReader.Picker.class, callNativeMethodsByDefault=true) public class ShadowNativeImageReader extends Object
